dedupe_keys.name: orphaned well naip imagery acquisition scripts

description: Los Alamos National Laboratory publishes scripts for obtaining aerial imagery around documented orphaned wells. The repository describes a coordinate-to-metadata workflow through the USGS M2M API, image acquisition using Selenium, a precomputed bounding-box table and an example batch submission. Source access is public and free under BSD 3-Clause. Coverage follows US National Agriculture Imagery Program scenes and the supplied well locations. The tools can prepare training material for asset inventories used in environmental-risk and remediation simulations, alongside platform-qgis. A caveat is that access to upstream imagery and automated acquisition depends on current USGS services and account requirements. Bounding boxes and visual features do not prove a well’s operating or ownership status. No acquisition script, login or image download was attempted.
